question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**intolerable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes Shan’s emotional distress after his mother’s passing.
 
• The appropriate word should indicate extreme difficulty and suffering.
 
• "**Intolerable**" fits well as it means something unbearable, aligning with the context of his grief.
 
• Other options ("**comfortable**", "**satisfactory**", "**ecstatic**") do not fit the theme of loss and suffering.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Comfortable (आरामदायक): "Comfortable" means providing ease and relaxation, which does not suit the context of emotional pain.
 
• Satisfactory (संतोषजनक): "Satisfactory" means acceptable or fulfilling requirements, which does not describe extreme grief.
 
• Ecstatic (उत्साही): "Ecstatic" means extremely happy, which contradicts the tone of loss and suffering in the passage.
